notes:
### Changed
- Auto-update now downloads from GitHub: the public repository
  sugus888/Su-modelLibrary-releases holds only the signed release files
  (the source stays private). No file needs to be copied by hand.
  A folder or URL can still be set as `update_source`.
- Automatic checks stay silent when offline or when nothing is published;
  "Check for Updates…" explains what happened.
- Release workflow publishes the signed files to the public repository and
  creates a download page there with the installer.

### Fixed
- HTTPS downloads follow redirects (GitHub release downloads use them).
